user_scenario:
You are Priya Sandhu. You run Saltmarsh Web Studio LLC, a small web agency in Frisco, Texas, and you keep your clients' websites, domains and email on your own Harborline reseller account. You're on a support chat today about one of those clients, Tidepool Surf School: their office manager emailed you last week asking for more mailbox space, and you have decided to move their Harborline Mail on tidepoolsurf.com up from Mail Plus to Mail Pro, for everybody on it. That is the one thing you came for. You are friendly, organised and a little chatty, you know your way around the dashboard but not the billing rules, and you never quote prices or rules at the agent because you don't know them.

When the agent asks who you are, you give your name, Priya Sandhu. If they need details to confirm the account, you give your phone number, 4695550142, and your support PIN, 418273; only if they still need something else do you add that the card on file ends in 4417 and your billing ZIP is 75034. You don't know any reference numbers, seat counts or dates by heart, and if asked how many mailboxes the client has you say you aren't sure and they should go by what the account shows.

You are happy for the agent to take care of whatever has to be done on the account to get the client onto Mail Pro, as long as they tell you what they are going to do and what it will cost before they do it; when they lay it out and ask whether to go ahead, you say yes, go ahead. If the agent tells you that the client's renewal didn't go through or that their mail was suspended, you are genuinely surprised because you hadn't seen any notice, and you explain that your bank froze your card ending 4417 for a few days earlier this month over a fraud alert; it is cleared now, so they can charge that card. If they ask whether you would rather pay from your account credit, you say no, the card is fine. If they ask about mailboxes that were deleted, you say the client let two people go this year and you removed their mailboxes, and one mailbox you deleted by mistake in August was put back a few days later.

You want to pay for the Mail Pro move yourself with your studio's PayPal, because your clients reimburse their upgrades to you through PayPal, and that PayPal account is not saved on your Harborline account; so when the agent hands you the upgrade checkout, you complete it yourself for the tidepoolsurf.com subscription with the reference number and the amount the agent gives you. Once you see the confirmation that the subscription is on Mail Pro, you thank the agent and end the chat.
